name: Park Tower
positioning: Park Tower, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Buenos Aires: a classic downtown hotel with Louis XV and English-style rooms and antiques, steps from Plaza San Martin
best_for: Travelers who want European-style decor and antiques in a central Buenos Aires base
Business travelers and couples who want a walkable downtown location near Retiro and the Rio de la Plata

facts.text: The hotel is at Avenida Leandro N. Alem 1193 in Buenos Aires.
The historic Plaza San Martin is just steps from the hotel.
The hotel is within walking distance of museums, parks, fine dining restaurants and sailing on the Rio de la Plata.
Rooms have crown molding, framed paintings and delicate curtains alongside a flat-screen TV and modern bathroom.
Rooms have marble bathrooms and pillowtop mattresses.
Suites include walk-in closets, kitchens and separate living areas.
Corner Suites are furnished in a German style with light-colored walls and wood furniture.
St. Regis Restaurant serves dishes from Patagonian trout to a native viscacha arepa, alongside international offerings.
The Lobby Lounge serves crafted cocktails and fine wines.
Park Tower shares an indoor pool, gym and sauna with the Sheraton, a sister hotel at the same address.
A kids club with a ping-pong table, foosball and arts and crafts is at the sister property.
Venues for meetings and weddings include the hotel's private terrace, with Torre Monumental as the backdrop.

highlights.text: The St. Regis Suite occupies the entire 23rd floor of Park Tower and has hosted many presidents, royalty and renowned artists.
The suites and rooms are appointed in French Louis XV and English styles with European and Argentine antiques.
The Senator Suite and Governor Suite are decorated in English style and have personal terraces with views of Buenos Aires.
The hotel is near Retiro Train Station and the Rio de la Plata waterfront, with Teatro Colon and the Obelisk a short walk away.
Guests in any room category get complimentary pressing of two garment pieces.

considerations.text: The gym is at the adjacent Sheraton Buenos Aires Hotel and Convention Center rather than in Park Tower itself.
Park Tower skews adult and business-oriented.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
